description: This file defines a React functional component called MenuSwitchButtonItem, which renders a button with a switch and optional keyboard shortcut indicator, encapsulated within a menu list item. It handles properties like checked state, onChange handler, disabled state, and accessibility attributes.

methods.name: MenuSwitchButtonItem
methods.description: A React component that renders a menu item with a toggle switch and optional keyboard shortcut indicator, supporting focus management and ARIA roles for accessibility.
